g.title: begin
g.text: Copper PC rewind, per-scanline change logs

g.title: step
g.text: CPU executes; contention applied per access

g.title: devs
g.text: Copper, CTC, DMA, UART, audio accumulation,
scanline boundary work, then the IM2 tick
and the /INT window for the next boundary

g.title: comp
g.text: the WHOLE frame in one pass, replaying each
row's change log immediately before the row
